runtimeMapping.trait: Native Crusher WALK Physical/Melee CAST selector limitedMaxTargetNumToBlockedCnt1/allowZeroBlockCntLimit0 maps current block-capacity victim cap with blocked priority plus legal ordinary in-range enemies. Each victim receives one separately mitigated source Attack event .7; no inherited blanket AoE or arbitrary maxTargets.
runtimeMapping.talent1: Native ON_CALCULATE_DAMAGE tests literal STUNNED/UNMOVABLE then selected atk_scale, otherwise atk_scale_2. Direct scoped hit callback multiplies pre-mitigation attack amount; does not scale native sourceless DoT or direct self-drain.
runtimeMapping.talent2: Source ContinuousApplyBuff selfOption1/b-1/current facing plus ally motionALL/purposeNONE; native damage_resistance PHYSICAL_AND_MAGICAL/nonstack maps strongest owned Sanctuary18/21, self and directly-behind allied unit. Independent friendly target-free/isolation checks and source removal preserve unrelated owned Sanctuary.
runtimeMapping.s1: Selected single offensive-SP charge replaces one attack family with source Skill_1 event.7/cap1 and selected1.6..2.6 full Physical coefficient, keeping current block-capacity victim count. Native INPUT timing1 retains startup victims. One selected10..25% current max-HP heal at accepted family start, respecting HealFree. Source pre-emission dead-input charge recovery is separate from emitted owned kills or accepted control.
runtimeMapping.s2: Native switching controller consumes selected5..10 SP in each direction. Instant casts toggle one persistent stance; passive selected ATK percentage survives both states. Native attribute8/formula0 maps flat BAT+.5, attribute5/formula0 adds block1. Stance attacks use literal alternate A/B.767/cap1 and source Stun1; begins/ends.2 literal action/SP form locks are scoped mode transitions, not a free manualCancel.
runtimeMapping.s3: All selected seventy seconds, HP/ATK percentages and forward range+1; original Begin1.5/Idle/Loop.7/End.2 aliases. One five-percent max-HP heal per accepted family and per-victim25% original stun2..5. Self FixedValueDamage PURE100/1s ignoreForSp/skipModifierEvent maps lethal direct HP loss, unaffected by ordinary shield/Fragile. Parent marks attach on hostile output/take damage, independent source keys, infinite derived1s wait-first ticks at source PURE200. NoSourceDamage is sourceless with credited source, no outgoing source talent/multiplier; ordinary target mitigation/shields/Fragile remain. Parent end/withdraw/death clears owned marks/drain, no spatial detach.

verificationLimits: Original executable C# ability/FSM/attribute dispatch is not recovered. Exact selected ranks, nested templates, native flags and original events are preserved; no recorded-client frame parity is claimed.

ON_ABILITY_SPELL_ON self-heal is explicitly mapped to one accepted attack-family startup, before its original release event, as the matching prior Flamebringer adapter. Native event phase/one-versus-per-target emission has not been executed independently; healTarget TARGET is retained literally and official description binds self healing.

Native activeBuff Stun is mapped before the same victim ON_CALCULATE_DAMAGE, so a successfully newly stunned victim receives the stronger talent scale; rejected immunity preserves ordinary scale. Exact C# active-buff/calculation dispatch order remains an explicit interpretation.

Source INPUT1 and recoverSpIfTargetDead1 map dead entire pre-emission input-family recovery, not living invalid targets, emitted kills or control cancellation. Native partial multi-target dead-input charge semantics and canceled pending reentry remain unrecovered.

Native switch controller restartFSM0 and animation ReplaceAnimation loopType1 are retained. Adapter uses literal.2 begin/end action/SP lock and alternating A/B; native mode-state entry/exit with an already-running ability, loop counter initial phase and cooldown handoff remain unrecovered.

S3 buff/counter clocks start at skill activation while literal Begin1.5 gates ordinary attacks. Its BuffAttack waitForAttackEvent1 has no separate serialized attack event in Begin; exact native buff application/Begin completion phase remains a bounded mode interpretation, not inferred event parity.

ON_OUTPUT_DAMAGE and ON_TAKE_DAMAGE are mapped to ordinary pre-mitigation hit notification after shared invulnerability eligibility. Dodged/shielded emissions can attach derived marks; native cancellation/zero-value callback order is not recovered. Literal source has no NORMAL damage filter; HP loss and element-gauge paths do not create damage modifiers here.

FixedValueDamage self-drain skipModifierEvent/considerUnhurtablefalse/triggerOnCalculateDamagefalse maps direct applyHpLoss with HP-loss classification to suppress ordinary modifier reactions and SP. Native nonstandard fatal/HP-floor/hit-count event exceptions have not been recovered. NoSourceDamage enemy ticks retain ordinary-stage target-side/shield pipeline and kill credit, not a direct kill shortcut.

Source Sanctuary purposeNONE ignores healing-specific restrictions while keeping target-free/friendly isolation rules. Exact native purpose-mask/profession/category enum dispatch is not executable here; source scope and current self-option interpretation remain explicit.
Original Unity particles/audio are retained identifiers only; feedback effects are approximations.
